findings.message: The crude-product NMR analysis and use of 1,2-dimethoxyethane as internal standard are omitted. Preserve this analytical operation as unmapped because the supported step types do not represent NMR analysis.

The purification evidence retains the conditions, but the operational representation does not capture the silica stationary phase or petroleum ether/EtOAc eluent range. Preserve these details explicitly as unmapped conditions; the closed Purify fields cannot encode them separately.
